watch.summary: The streamer lines up a guaranteed kill on a blinded enemy in Valorant while a confident meme plays, only to immediately get killed instead.

beats.what: Streamer peaks around a corner in Valorant.
He spots a blinded enemy standing right in front of him.
Meme insert of Gambit saying 'You know how long I've been waiting for this'.
Cut back to gameplay where the streamer is instantly headshot and dead on the floor.
Streamer screams in complete disbelief that the blinded enemy killed him.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The contrast between the extreme confidence build-up from the Gambit meme and the instant, unceremonive death creates perfect comedic subversion. His loud, hilarious reaction tops off the fail perfectly.
